chronology: Followup informed by exposed native and photo R values and quadratic content null; signed before any execution of this new window-origin contrast. Not globally blind research.
question: Can a one-pixel window-origin contrast separate a quadratic-content cumulant from a period2 process response, and can non-generator scene texture produce the same contrast?

measurement.support: Same patch count at translated image windows; never circularly shift a patch. Floor unused partial interior edges explicitly. Remove each patch DC before nonDC DFT for numerical precision.
measurement.joint: Q_delta=kappa(U_k1,U_k2*,U_k3,U_k4*) of centered empirical patch distribution, with all three pairings
measurement.numeric_floor: Each averaged power must exceed max((1e-12*patch*max|field|)^2,1e-12*max_averaged_power); otherwise S=None. This is not a confidence gate.
measurement.scope: Finite-window descriptive processing contrast, not a cyclic spectrum estimator for a stationary ensemble, bounded correlation, AI probability or noise/scale/JPEG invariant

NN_signs.field: Binary deBruijn order9 cycle length512; 8 rows of coarse cycle shifted by row index, 64 patches per row, NN repeat along x; every nine-sign word appears exactly once at the 512 window pairs. Extra fine pixel permits genuine shifted window.
NN_signs.exact_finite_boundary: Q_1=-7/8*Q_0, not -Q_0: seven complete pairs reverse phase; two edge singletons cancel at cycle8
NN_signs.routes: Closed formula versus independent 512-sign enumeration and linear DFT coefficient propagation; then full single-image production measurement and transposed-y twin

controls.quadratic: I(y,x)=2*(x/255)^2-1,256x256; centered x coefficients independent of window delta, hence Q0=Q1, C=0 and S=0; y undefined
controls.scene_carrier: I(y,x)=(0.5+0.5*y/255)*cos(2*pi*x/8),256x256; x pure Q1=-Q0; S=6*(14^2+1)/(5*(14^2-1))=394/325. Mathematical scene field, no generator or resampling; cross undefined because powers vanish.
controls.zeros: All Q,C,D zero; normalized values None, not a natural-class verdict
corruptions: wrong conjugation must disagree with known complex Q
zero undefined replaced by numeric class score must fail

cached_data.coverage: 32 native branches in both unclipped float RGB and PNG, six old photo PNG views; no new generator forward, source image, held/reserved pixels or baseline
cached_data.gates: Only after all analytic controls pass; receipt and pixel file SHA before reading. No parameter scan or threshold/classifier fit.
cached_data.timing: Measure first three cached views with same code, then record bounded remainder projection and per-view costs. No inferred deployment speed.

decision: Even if content null is eliminated, non-generator carrier control is a preregistered counterexample to AI specificity; do not promote this descriptor to a detector solely for nonzero response.
